subject: general
question:
Eight friends. A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Only D is sitting between A and E. E is sitting second to the right of F. Only B is sitting between C and G. Only F is sitting between G and H.

What is F's position with respect to D?
solution:
**Given:**

Eight friends. A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

**Solution:**

(1) Only D is sitting between A and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fabedf24b009a0425614cac354a3b6f9d0457e32acf322636190ad5cf6603f0a.png] 

(2) E is sitting second to the right of F.

 
• only **case 1 is possible** because the second left of E is occupied by A in case 2. </spa
